description.overview: This lab demonstrates reflected XSS in a Sportswear Store.
learning_objectives: Identify reflected user input in an HTML response
Exploit reflected XSS with a simple script payload
Fix the issue using output encoding
description.student_task: Find the unsafe handling of user-controlled input and patch it securely.
description.expected_fix: Apply safe output encoding before rendering user-controlled input.

scenario.name: Sportswear Store
scenario.story: A Sportswear Store allows users to submit or view user-controlled content.
scenario.attacker_goal: Exploit reflected XSS through unsafe user input handling.
scenario.real_world_impact: Account compromise, phishing, session exposure, admin compromise, or malicious redirection.

vulnerability.complexity: single input, single page, obvious source-to-sink
vulnerability.vulnerable_behavior: User-controlled input reaches an HTML/DOM sink without proper escaping.
vulnerability.secure_behavior: User-controlled input is safely encoded before reaching the sink.
